definitions.explanation: The stimulant found in coffee, tea, and many soft drinks that helps keep one awake and alert.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カフェイン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Coffee has a lot of caffeine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カフェイン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らない→取る：00565_toru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try not to take in caffeine at night.

examples.japanese: カフェイン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなく→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Taking in too much caffeine can be a cause of being unable to sleep.

notes:
A loanword (from English "caffeine"). Found in coffee, tea, and energy drinks; valued as a stimulant but a concern when consumed in excess.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カフェイン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: take in / consume caffeine
- カフェイン{入|い}り: containing caffeine
- カフェインレス: caffeine-free (decaf)
- カフェイン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ: too much caffeine
